entries.title: Hyperbolic lexical hierarchy recovery
entries.statement: A declared Poincare representation improves held-out WordNet hypernym recovery over matched Euclidean and random controls.
entries.contrary_result: The v0 public pilot did not show a hyperbolic advantage on its pinned sample.
entries.next_obligation: Choose an independently pinned lexical benchmark and predeclare a new representation family before another run.

entries.title: Hyperbolic DNA representation advantage
entries.statement: A declared hyperbolic DNA sequence representation improves held-out classification over matched Euclidean and random controls on a pinned public dataset.
entries.contrary_result: On the pinned public Genomic Benchmarks non-TATA promoter pilot, the Poincare prototype had no fixed-seed positive 95% paired-bootstrap AUROC lower bound over the matched Euclidean prototype.
entries.next_obligation: Retain this negative result. A new candidate requires a new frozen protocol and an independent replication on a separately pinned task; it may not alter the original result.

entries.title: Legacy E8 transform adds predictive value
entries.statement: A precisely specified legacy E8 feature transform adds held-out value beyond matched non-E8 controls on a public source-derived task.
entries.contrary_result: A hash/modulo assignment, a non-reproducible transform, or no incremental value rejects the hypothesis.
entries.next_obligation: Write an adapter dossier and source-derived feature contract before any evaluation.
